c2_3_post_erasure_decision_rule.sum_mlp_definition: sum_{l=L+1}^{31} (u_t . (mlp_out_l^{int}(last) - mlp_out_l^{clean}(last))) / r_c(p), evaluated on logit_lens arm at layer L, positions='last', dose=0.75*pmn[L]
c2_3_post_erasure_decision_rule.statistic: E_open(L) = median_{t in open_18, p in 8}(sum_mlp(L,t,p)); E_func(L) = median_{t in func_6, p in 8}(sum_mlp(L,t,p)); ret_open(L) = median_{t in open_18, p in 8}(retention(L,t,p)); ret_rand(L) = median_{d in 8, p in 8}(retention_rand_iso(L,d,p))
c2_3_post_erasure_decision_rule.post_erasure_predicate: E_open(L) >= -1.20 logits AND |E_open(L) - E_func(L)| <= 0.60 logits AND ret_open(L) > ret_rand(L)
c2_3_post_erasure_decision_rule.selection_rule: Stage C3 compilation band = earliest contiguous run of >= 2 sweep layers in {18, 21, 24, 27, 30} satisfying post_erasure(L); if none, C2.3 = INCONCLUSIVE and Stage C3 defaults to {24, 27}
